title: Optimize_Prime@DravidianLangTech-ACL2022: Abusive Comment Detection in Tamil
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting abusive language such as misogyny, homophobia, and xenophobia in Tamil social media comments as part of an NLP shared task. While it deals with social bias and offensive content, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or formal systems of morals and ethics.
